chunks: And it was narrated from Abū Zakariyyā al-Aʿwar, who said:

I saw Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام performing salat while standing, and beside him was an elderly man who wanted to stand up and had a staff with him. The man wanted to reach for it, so Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام bent down while remaining standing in his salat and handed the man the staff. Then he returned to his place, to his salat.
ai.seo_question: Can a person make a small movement during salat to help someone without invalidating the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith describes Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام briefly assisting an elderly man during salat without discontinuing the prayer. It highlights the permissibility of slight movement in salat when needed and reflects attentiveness to the needs of others.
